instruction.text: Use multiplication and division to solve the following problems.

hint.text: When writing values of money involving pounds and pence, make sure to write the price in full. For example, write 2.50 instead of just 2.5.
hint.sound: When writing values of money involving pounds and pence, make sure to write the price in full. For example, write 2 point 5 0 instead of just 2 point 5.

atoms.a: If 2 loaves of bread cost £2.20, how much do 3 loaves of bread cost?
The 35 players in a football club are split into 5 teams. How many players are in 2 teams?
For every 10 kilometres a man runs, he burns 620 calories. How many calories would he burn for a 3-kilometre run?
In April, the UK gets an average of 60 mm of rain. How many millimetres of rain would be expected in 10 of these days.
